---
name: Reconstruction or inventory task
about: Claim a bounded native family, executable inventory or platform task
title: "[Decomp] "
---

## Scope and identity

List the measured build, program/module identity, address range and ARM/Thumb mode where applicable. Name the owned files and output paths, related issues and shared dependencies.

## Evidence and remaining work

Link existing public source, findings and sanitized receipts. State what is observed, what is inferred and what remains unknown.

## Acceptance criteria

List the concrete results and checks needed to close this task. Distinguish exact matching, source linking, bounded behavior, independent replay and platform execution. State the denominator and unsupported cases for any coverage claim.

## Claim and handoff

Read existing comments before claiming a range. Comment with your exact scope and recheck for concurrent claims. Release the claim if you stop. Post commits, checks actually run, evidence and remaining work after publishing a change. Partial work leaves the issue open.

Do not attach original archives, ROMs/CIAs, extracted game payloads, original-gap objects, hybrid images, keys or saves. Check logs and attachments before posting.
